title: I’ve created a virtual card game;
author: Moist_Show7700
selftext:
although it’s a prototype, I hope everyone enjoys it. You can find the game here: [https://mrody25.itch.io/sotacabrona](https://mrody25.itch.io/sotacabrona) . Have fun! Oh, and by the way, it’s also available for mobile... BUILT with Claude.



I created the illustrations using ChatGPT and developed almost the entire game with Claude, though the OpenCode programming agent (Big Pickle) helped me turn it into an application for desktop and Android. All the AI ​​tools I use are free, and I really push them to their limits. I’d like to further optimize things to make the experience smoother—both for me and for my players. For instance, I’d love to be able to work on the mobile and desktop versions simultaneously, or implement a reliable update system that ensures player data isn’t lost every time I release an update. If you have any suggestions, please leave them in the comments. And don’t forget to give it a try! ;)
